OPEN-SOURCE RUNTIME REQUIREMENT
No proprietary AI or hosted LLM belongs in the inventory path. Use deterministic open-source components and contracts. OpenAPI is an open API standard, not OpenAI.

MISSION
Wire pilotsalesdistribution.com to verified PSE/SalesMax inventory without exposing private data, publishing stale deals, or creating an unrecoverable deployment.

FIRST ACTION
Read 00_START_HERE.md and execute 02_IMPLEMENTATION/03_PHASE_0_DISCOVERY_WORKSHEET.md. Do not write production code until the repository, framework, host, current data source, deployment path and rollback method are evidenced.

MANDATORY ARCHITECTURE
Private intake -> evidence quarantine -> reconciliation -> private canonical master -> explicit publish gate -> separate public snapshot -> server-only API/cache -> website.

AUTHORITATIVE CONTRACTS
- 03_CONTRACTS/canonical_inventory_record.schema.json
- 03_CONTRACTS/public_inventory_item.schema.json
- 03_CONTRACTS/public_inventory_snapshot.schema.json
- 03_CONTRACTS/public_inventory_api.openapi.yaml
- 03_CONTRACTS/publish_gate_rules.json
- 03_CONTRACTS/freshness_policy.json

PROHIBITED
- Browser or client bundle access to private Sheets/Hub credentials.
- Returning supplier, acquisition cost, sell floor, margin, proof, owner, reviewer or private notes.
- Treating NOW() or page-load time as inventory verification.
- Publishing without explicit approval, positive ATS, source IDs/hashes, current confirmation, approved public terms and HTTPS assets.
- Public prices in RFQ/login mode; null prices in public mode.
- Duplicate Deal IDs, public slugs, source record IDs or source hashes across approved deals.
- Replacing a valid non-empty snapshot with empty/malformed output without an explicit, separately authorized action.
- Enabling checkout before holds/reservations and order commitment controls exist.

IMPLEMENTATION ORDER
1. Evidence Phase 0 discovery, backup and rollback.
2. Reconcile current source rows into one canonical record per deal.
3. Add all required private and public fields from the canonical data dictionary.
4. Build the allowlist publisher; adapt the tested reference behavior to the actual stack.
5. Create a separate public feed/database view and distinct machine identities.
6. Implement list/detail API, ETag, pagination, rate limits, last-known-good and fail-closed behavior.
7. Implement signed revalidation exactly per 05_INTEGRATION/05_HMAC_REVALIDATION_SPEC.md.
8. Wire catalog/detail/RFQ and remove unsupported claims/filters.
9. Add monitoring, incident and rollback controls.
10. Run the packet gauntlet, then the live production acceptance matrix.
11. Perform two clean end-to-end runs and prove rollback.

NO COMPLETION CLAIM
Do not call the production integration complete until feed/API/site parity, privacy, freshness, sold/withdrawn, RFQ identity, monitoring, rollback and clean repeatability all pass with stored evidence.
